name: Non-skid deck (moulded)

boats.J22: deck, cabin top, cockpit seats and sole (hero bake detail mask R; M_BoatSurface NonSkid > 0)
boats.Sunfish: deck moulded pattern (same surface kind; its own pattern is not measured yet, see refs open items)

closest_camera_note: helm eye looking down at the seat and sole; the feet sit on it

pattern.kind: moulded diagonal ribs (twill-like), one dominant direction at about 45 degrees to the boat's fore-aft axis, a faint cross texture

wear_reads.time: rib tops polished flat in foot paths, slight yellowing, sanded scuffs
wear_reads.dirt: grey-tan grime in the grooves and in blotches along foot paths, black mildew specks on a neglected boat

replaces: Tools/boats/make_detail_textures.py nonskid(): 45-degree grid of rounded pyramids, 2.5 mm pitch, both diagonals equal (High and Ultra only)
scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE: the 8 mm analytic diamond (k = 2 pi / 0.8 cm) every tier draws where NonSkid > 0, 3.5x the measured pitch
scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE surf == 2 detail branch: grime in the grooves from one dirt number

budget.medium: no new maps; shader math only
budget.high: keep the one 1024 px N/M pair (100 mm tile) at the same memory; no extra texture reads
budget.ultra: optional 2048 px pair later (plan allows it for non-skid)

owner_files: scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE surf == 2 detail branch and the non-skid grime line
